b'# tinydl

A small command-line downloader. It fetches a URL with retries (3 attempts, 20 s timeout) and writes the bytes to a file or to stdout.

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |
'
